title: PMSM FeedForward Control
text: Decouple d -axis and q -axis current to eliminate disturbance, 7 inputs, 2 outputs, {Motor parameter input method} sets Type of motor; {Number of pole pairs}, {Vsat input method} sets the input method for Vsat Specify, {Output saturation (V)} sets the saturation limit for output values 24/sqrt, {D-axis current breakpoint vector (A)} sets the d-axis current lookup, {Q-axis current breakpoint vector (A)} sets the q-axis current lookup, {Stator d-axis inductance (H)} sets the d-axis stator winding, {Stator q-axis inductance (H)} sets the q-axis stator winding, {Permanent magnet flux linkage (Wb)} sets the pM flux linkage 6.4e-3, {D-axis flux linkage LUT, FluxD(id,iq) (Wb)} sets the d-axis flux linkage lookup data, {Q-axis flux linkage LUT, FluxQ(id,iq) (Wb)} sets the q-axis flux linkage lookup data, {Ld LUT, Ld(id,iq) (H)} sets the d-axis inductance lookup data 0.2e-3 *, {Lq LUT, Lq(id,iq) (H)} sets the q-axis inductance lookup data 0.2e-3 *, {PM flux linkage LUT, FluxPM(id,iq) (Wb)} sets the pM flux linkage lookup data 6.4e-3 * ones, {Input units} sets the unit of input values Per-Unit, {Base voltage (V)} sets the nominal voltage limit 24/sqrt, {Base current (A)} sets the nominal current limit, {Base speed (rpm)} sets the nominal speed limit and {Allow scaled-down motor parameters with CodeGen (higher precision with Fixed-Point data type)} scales down internal parameters to match per-unit. Values come from the instance.
